curriculum.course_title: Illinois Learning Standards for Mathematics (incorporating the Common Core), Grades 1-5
curriculum.note: Companion inventory to IL-G6-G8-CCSS. Illinois adopts Common Core verbatim; identifiers are canonical CCSS codes.

source_notes: Illinois adopted the Common Core State Standards verbatim through ISBE rulemaking effective 2010-10-28; the Illinois Learning Standards for Mathematics incorporate the CCSS without identifier changes.
Expectation identifiers, domain/cluster structure, and statement text are identical to the canonical CCSS set; per-expectation text is carried from the reviewed DC CCSS inventory (same source).
Jurisdiction isolation: identical CCSS identifiers appear in other adopters' inventories (DC, MD legacy crosswalk columns). Illinois rows must never merge with those rows by identifier similarity.
Illinois has no repository packs, seeds, or skills; every row is NO_REPOSITORY_SPECIFIC_MAPPING_FOUND pending Standards Mapping work.

reconciliation.warning: Illinois has zero repository coverage; identifier-set clone of the reviewed DC CCSS inventory establishes official scope only, not coverage.
